Parent issue: #37

Stage: caption-workflow

## Task

Parent issue: #37

Stage: caption-workflow

## Task

Implement the GitHub Actions workflow and supporting scripts for downloading YouTube captions and translating them to Chinese.

This PR stacks on top of the caption-infra PR (#41), which added `quartz/components/Transcript.tsx`, `content/captions/.gitkeep`, and the `captionEn`/`captionZh` frontmatter convention.

## Goal

Add a manually-triggered GitHub Actions workflow (`workflow_dispatch`) that:
1. Downloads English auto-captions from a YouTube URL via `yt-dlp`
2. Converts the raw VTT to clean paragraph markdown
3. Translates the English markdown to Chinese using the Anthropic Claude API
4. Commits both `content/captions/<episode_id>.en.md` and `content/captions/<episode_id>.zh.md` to a new branch and opens a PR

## Files to create

### 1. `.github/workflows/agent-caption-update.yml` (new)

`workflow_dispatch` trigger with required inputs:
- `episode_id`: string (e.g. `ep01`) — used as filename prefix
- `youtube_url`: string — full YouTube video URL

Workflow steps:
- Checkout repo (full history not needed; depth 1 is fine)
- Set up Node.js (use the version already configured in the repo, e.g. 20)
- Install `yt-dlp` (use `pip install yt-dlp` or `pipx install yt-dlp`)
- Download EN auto-captions: `yt-dlp --write-auto-sub --sub-lang en --no-warnings --skip-download -o '/tmp/caption' "${{ inputs.youtube_url }}"`  — this outputs a file like `/tmp/caption.en.vtt`
- Convert VTT to markdown: `node .agent/scripts/vtt-to-md.js /tmp/caption.en.vtt content/captions/${{ inputs.episode_id }}.en.md`
- Translate to Chinese: `node .agent/scripts/translate-caption.js content/captions/${{ inputs.episode_id }}.en.md content/captions/${{ inputs.episode_id }}.zh.md`
- Configure git user (use `github-actions[bot]` / `github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com`)
- Create branch `caption/${{ inputs.episode_id }}`, commit both files, push
- Open PR against `main` with title `captions: add ${{ inputs.episode_id }} EN+ZH transcripts` using `gh pr create`
- The workflow needs `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` from secrets and `GITHUB_TOKEN` for the PR step

### 2. `.agent/scripts/vtt-to-md.js` (new)

Node.js CLI: reads a `.vtt` file (argv[2]) and writes clean markdown prose to argv[3].

Logic:
- Strip the `WEBVTT` header line
- Skip lines that are cue identifiers (pure numeric or timestamp-only lines)
- Strip timestamp lines (`HH:MM:SS.mmm --> HH:MM:SS.mmm`)
- Strip VTT inline tags (`<c>`, `<00:00:00.000>`, etc.) using a regex
- Deduplicate consecutive repeated caption segments (YouTube auto-captions often repeat the previous line with minor additions)
- Join caption text into paragraphs (group ~3–5 sentences, or break on long pauses if timing info is available)
- Output clean UTF-8 markdown to the output path

### 3. `.agent/scripts/translate-caption.js` (new)

Node.js CLI: reads an English markdown file (argv[2]) and writes Chinese markdown to argv[3].

Uses `@anthropic-ai/sdk` (already in the agent runtime / available via npm install).
- Split content into chunks of ~800 tokens to stay within context limits
- For each chunk: call Claude API (`claude-sonnet-4-6` or `claude-haiku-4-5-20251001` for cost) with a system prompt: "You are a professional translator. Translate the following English podcast transcript to Simplified Chinese. Preserve paragraph breaks. Output only the translation, no commentary."
- Reassemble chunks in order and write to output path
- Use `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` env var

## Constraints
- Do NOT modify any existing episode `.md` files or the Transcript component from PR #41
- The workflow must be manually triggered only (`workflow_dispatch`); do not add push triggers
- Script files go under `.agent/scripts/` (not `scripts/` root) to match existing agent tooling conventions
- Use `node` built-ins where possible; keep npm dependencies minimal
- The parent issue is #37

## Base

- base_pr: #41
